buildPhases.name: Run Script: Delete Unnecessary Frameworks For Share Extension
buildPhases.scriptContents:
if [ "${CONFIGURATION}" = "Release" ]; then
# Delete the framework that Xcode should have never included
# https://forums.swift.org/t/is-this-an-xcode-bug-or-somehow-related-to-spm/33987
rm -rf "${TARGET_BUILD_DIR}/${PLUGINS_FOLDER_PATH}/NetNewsWire Share Extension.appex/Contents/Frameworks"

# Re-sign to update the expected files in the signature
codesign --verbose --force -o runtime --preserve-metadata=entitlements --sign "${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY}" "${TARGET_BUILD_DIR}/${PLUGINS_FOLDER_PATH}/NetNewsWire Share Extension.appex"
fi

buildPhases.name: Run Script: Verify No Build Settings
Run Script: Code Sign Sparkle
buildPhases.scriptContents:
if [ "${CONFIGURATION}" = "Release" ]; then
# Remove unused Sparkle components
SPARKLE_DIR="${CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH}/Contents/Frameworks/Sparkle.framework"
find "${SPARKLE_DIR}" -name Updater.app -execdir rm -rf {} \;
find "${SPARKLE_DIR}" -name Autoupdate -execdir rm -rf {} \;

PLUGINS_DIR="${CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH}/Contents/PlugIns"
XPC_DIR="${CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH}/Contents/XPCServices"
find "${PLUGINS_DIR}" -name Sparkle* -execdir rm -rf {} \;
find "${XPC_DIR}" -name Sparkle* -execdir rm -rf {} \;

# Re-sign Sparkle after removing components
codesign --verbose --force -o runtime --preserve-metadata=entitlements --sign "${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY}" "${CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH}/Contents/Frameworks/Sparkle.framework"

# Sign XPC Helpers and their internal binaries
codesign --verbose --force -o runtime --preserve-metadata=entitlements --sign "${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY}" "${CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH}/Contents/XPCServices/org.sparkle-project.InstallerLauncher.xpc/Contents/MacOS/Updater.app"
codesign --verbose --force -o runtime --preserve-metadata=entitlements --sign "${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY}" "${CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH}/Contents/XPCServices/org.sparkle-project.InstallerLauncher.xpc/Contents/MacOS/Autoupdate"
codesign --verbose --entitlements "${PROJECT_DIR}/submodules/Sparkle/Downloader/org.sparkle-project.Downloader.entitlements" --force -o runtime --sign "${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY}" "${CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH}/Contents/XPCServices/org.sparkle-project.Downloader.xpc"
codesign --verbose --force -o runtime --preserve-metadata=entitlements --sign "${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY}" "${CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH}/Contents/XPCServices/org.sparkle-project.InstallerLauncher.xpc"
codesign --verbose --force -o runtime --preserve-metadata=entitlements --sign "${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY}" "${CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH}/Contents/XPCServices/org.sparkle-project.InstallerConnection.xpc"
codesign --verbose --force -o runtime --preserve-metadata=entitlements --sign "${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY}" "${CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH}/Contents/XPCServices/org.sparkle-project.InstallerStatus.xpc"
fi
